clue.text: Appeared to have reached land

definitions.meaning: something that appeared has been revealed or become known
to light is to alight or settle, as a bird lands on a branch

explanation.surface: A sailor or flier announces finally arriving on dry ground.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for being revealed or discovered also reads literally as having alighted or settled down.

clue.text: Leather worker who cooks Indian food

definitions.meaning: a tradesman who dresses and colours tanned hides
one who makes a curry, read as a playful agent noun

explanation.surface: A tanner who moonlights as a chef in an Indian restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: The trade name for a dresser of tanned hides doubles as a jokey word for someone who curries food.

clue.text: Make medic compete to acquire picture

parts.note: MO is the abbreviation for medical officer, a doctor
to vie is to compete

explanation.surface: A command to get the doctor to fight over a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture is an everyday word for a film shown at the cinema.

clue.text: Attacking is exciting

definitions.meaning: suddenly attacking them
turning someone on is arousing or exciting them

explanation.surface: A remark that an aggressive style of play is thrilling to watch.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb has two senses, rounding on someone in hostility and arousing their interest.

clue.text: The animal shelter is large and dry

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes
to air washing is to dry it out

explanation.surface: A description of a roomy, dry kennel for a pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild beast's den or resting place is its home shelter.

clue.text: Given information on it, I have a case

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: to be given the gen is to be given the information
taken as written
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: A lawyer briefed on a matter says they now have grounds to sue.
explanation.definitionFit: The possessive is one of the grammatical cases of nouns, as in Latin.

clue.text: A body of followers needing discipline

definitions.meaning: a retinue or line of attendants following a person
to discipline or school

explanation.surface: A remark that a group of disciples needs strict order.
explanation.definitionFit: A retinue trailing behind a dignitary is one sense; to drill or instruct someone is the other.

clue.text: Time to goose-step? Rubbish!

parts.note: a goose's step is a waddle, a rolling gait

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at a suggestion that soldiers should start marching stiffly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goose-step' suggests the military march, but here it means the way a goose actually walks.
explanation.definitionFit: Twaddle is silly talk, nonsense, so it works as an exclamation of disbelief.

clue.text: Garment found in Gilbert's ship

definitions.meaning: a sleeveless apron-like dress worn over clothes
The ship in the comic opera by Gilbert and Sullivan

explanation.surface: A piece of clothing turns up in a W S Gilbert opera.
explanation.definitionFit: The apron dress shares its name with the title vessel of the Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.

clue.text: Turning back to Scripture translation

parts.note: RE, religious education, is the school subject once called Scripture
a version is a rendering of a text into another language

explanation.surface: Someone returns to reading a new translation of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: A reversion is a return to an earlier state or practice, a going back.

clue.text: She can get back into motoring body

indicators.note: the reversed piece goes inside the motoring body

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring organisation

indicators.note: the word for can is read backwards, as if returning

parts.note: a tin is a can

explanation.surface: A woman hopes to rejoin a motoring club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' hides a woman's name; 'get back' turns the can's word round before 'into' sets it inside the Automobile Association's initials.
explanation.definitionFit: Anita is a woman's name, so a female pronoun stands in for it.

clue.text: Peaceful king held by rebellious Iceni

indicators.note: the king's letter is gripped inside the rearranged tribe
the tribe's letters revolt into a new order

parts.note: the Iceni were an ancient British tribe led by Boudicca
R is the abbreviation for rex, king

explanation.surface: A calm monarch is captured by Boudicca's rebellious tribe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebellious' rearranges ICENI to IENIC, and 'held by' puts R after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Irenic is a formal word meaning aimed at peace or conciliation.

clue.text: Model ensign

definitions.meaning: a model or norm to be measured against
a flag or banner

explanation.surface: Two words placed side by side: an exemplary flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A benchmark or norm is one sense; a military flag or banner is the other.

clue.text: Made singer give notice

indicators.note: the singer's letters are made into another word, remade

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone forced a vocalist to hand in their notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Made' is a loose anagram signal: the letters of SINGER are made over into a new order.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to give notice that one is leaving a job.

clue.text: Hurry to play set point

indicators.note: the letters of the tennis phrase are played about with

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A tennis player is urged to hurry and serve at a crucial point.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom, originally about pressing the accelerator, means go faster or hurry up.

clue.text: Exaggerated -that's anything but rare

definitions.meaning: overplayed or overstated, as an overacted role
meat cooked too long is the opposite of rare

explanation.surface: A diner complains a steak was far from rare.
explanation.definitionFit: Overplayed acting and meat cooked well past rare share the same word.

clue.text: Brew of Pilsner he has to stock up with anew

indicators.note: the beer and pronoun are brewed into a new mixture

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging
taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A drinker restocks his fridge with lager.
explanation.definitionFit: To replenish is to fill again or restore a supply.

clue.text: Healing a cleric around teatime

indicators.note: the clergyman's letters wrap round the time

parts.note: a curate is an assistant clergyman
four o'clock is traditional British teatime, IV in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A vicar's assistant offers healing over afternoon tea.
explanation.walkthrough: Four o'clock is the traditional British teatime, so it is written as the Roman numeral and wrapped inside the clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Something curative has the power to cure or heal.

clue.text: Trim many a joint with little fat

definitions.meaning: neat and tidy in appearance

definitions.text: many a joint with little fat
definitions.meaning: a lean joint of meat neatly cut with fat removed

explanation.surface: A butcher describes trimming the fat from a joint of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat and wholesome in looks is one sense; a butcher's lean cut of meat is the literal one.

clue.text: Bet I can make a cupboard!

indicators.note: the words are made into something new, rearranged

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: A carpenter boasts they can build a cupboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabinet is a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things.

clue.text: Laid out a banquet

definitions.meaning: opened out or set out flat
a lavish meal

explanation.surface: A host has laid on a grand feast.
explanation.definitionFit: Opened out flat is one sense; an abundant meal laid on a table is the other.

clue.text: Most crowded into gardens established long ago

indicators.note: the answer goes into, and so sits inside, the run of words

explanation.surface: Old gardens are densely packed with plants put in long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Densest is the superlative of dense, packed most tightly together.

clue.text: Liberal means to see US theatreland

parts.note: broad-minded, tolerant views are liberal ones
a way is a means or method

explanation.surface: A tolerant approach is the way to enjoy American theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: The New York avenue gives its name to the city's main commercial theatre district.

clue.text: Put down fertiliser from habit

definitions.meaning: to ... soil is to spread manure or compost on it
a habit is a long robe worn by monks or nuns, a garment

explanation.surface: A gardener's habit of always spreading manure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'habit' looks like a routine, but it is the religious garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Gardeners top-dress soil with fertiliser; a monk's habit is a type of clothing.

clue.text: Yank acquires a stylish jacket

parts.note: to yank is to jerk
in means fashionable

explanation.surface: An American buys a fashionable coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yank' looks like an American, but it is the verb meaning to pull sharply.
explanation.definitionFit: A jerkin is a sleeveless jacket, often of leather.

clue.text: Car key said to be of uniform colour

indicators.note: the clue words are heard, not read

parts.note: the phrase spoken in a non-rhotic accent

explanation.surface: An ignition key is described as matching the rest of the vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: In British pronunciation, with no R sounded, 'car key' sounds like the word for the drab military colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Khaki is the dull brownish colour of many army uniforms.

clue.text: A comedian wants to tease

definitions.meaning: a witty or eccentric person, a joker
to ... wool is to comb or tease out its fibres

explanation.surface: A stand-up likes to make fun of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tease' means mocking in the surface but is the wool-processing sense here.
explanation.definitionFit: An amusing joker is called a card; carding is combing out wool fibres, also called teasing.

clue.text: When I come in to pry, uproar results

indicators.note: the letter enters the word for pry

parts.note: to nose is to pry

explanation.surface: A row erupts when someone snoops into another's business.
explanation.definitionFit: Noise is loud sound, and an uproar is a noisy din.

clue.text: Dead dull

definitions.meaning: without life
lacking spirit or liveliness

explanation.surface: Two words: a lifeless, tedious thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Not alive at all is one sense; lifeless and lacking animation in manner is the other.

clue.text: He's certainly not one to buy with financial caution

definitions.text: He's certainly not one to buy with financial caution

parts.words: He's certainly not one to buy with financial caution
parts.note: describes a person who buys without care for money, a reckless waster

explanation.surface: A description of a careless shopper.
explanation.definitionFit: A spendthrift squanders money and is therefore the opposite of a careful buyer.
